name: inertia-scroll-marquee
title: Inertia Scroll Marquee
description: A dual-strip ticker banner with interactive swipe flick: dragging alters translation velocity, settling back smoothly to baseline crawl velocity.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Drag Acceleration Glide: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
